title: Listing Quality Program Standard — Quarterly Rating Assessment of Roamhaven Listings
content:
# Quarterly Rating Assessment

*Listing quality program standard for Roamhaven Listings.*

## 1. Which listings are assessed, and when

Every listing that is listed, snoozed or unlisted is assessed on the assessment dates of its space type's quality calendar. Each assessment is recorded on the listing with the quarter assessed, the average guest rating, the number of guest reviews and the outcome.

## 2. What is measured

- **Lookback window.** The space type's lookback in calendar days, ending on the day before the assessment date.
- **Guest reviews counted.** The reviews submitted by guests on stays of this listing whose posting date falls in the lookback window.
- **Average guest rating.** The mean of the ratings of those guest reviews, rounded half up to 2 decimal places.

## 3. How the outcome is decided

When the listing has fewer guest reviews in the lookback window than its space type's reviews figure, the outcome is **not assessed**. Otherwise the average guest rating decides it:

| Average guest rating | Outcome |
|---|---|
| below the space type's suspension figure | **suspension** — the listing is suspended with suspension reason quality |
| at or above the suspension figure but below the warning figure | **warning** |
| at or above the warning figure | **pass** |

The thresholds are those of the listing's own space type.

## 4. Effect of a quality suspension

A quality-suspended listing keeps its confirmed stays where its space type provides that confirmed stays go ahead, and it accepts no new bookings.

## 5. Boundary cases (hypothetical Entire Home listing; suspension figure 4.00, warning figure 4.30, reviews figure 5)

| Guest reviews in window | Average guest rating | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 3.20 | not assessed — fewer reviews than 5, so the rating is not used |
| 5 | 3.99 | suspension |
| 5 | 4.00 | warning — equal to the suspension figure is not below it |
| 12 | 4.29 | warning |
| 12 | 4.30 | pass — equal to the warning figure |

## 6. Rounding illustration (hypothetical ratings)

Three guest reviews of 4, 4 and 5 stars give a mean of 4.333…, which rounds half up to 4.33. Two reviews of 4 and 5 give 4.50 exactly.
